title: Braised Beef in German Beer Sauce
description: A hearty, comforting dish that's sure to warm the soul. This braised beef in German beer sauce is made with tender beef short ribs and a rich, malty sauce.
instructions: Season the short ribs with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the short ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the short ribs from the pot and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beer, beef broth, brown sugar, mustard, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the short ribs to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the short ribs for 2 1/2 hours, or until they are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the short ribs rest for 10 minutes before serving.
